_fix_shape_distribution: The anti-template check applied to the FIXES themselves (§10 guard 3): the 28 new endings are motion 11 · absence 10 · instruction 4 · fact 3 — 4 shapes, top share 39%, no replacement template. Computed BEFORE the batch landed and RE-COMPUTED after, which is how the two monocultures this lane built in its own fixes were caught and undone: (a) a fact-ending run in witch_hut and a three-motion run across witch_hollow's knot prop, and (b) — the serious one, found only by reading the 28 new strings aloud in sequence — NINE of them closing on a negative non-event ('Nobody comes to the door', 'Nothing to take until tomorrow', 'No door has been shown this one yet', 'There is no loose end to start from', 'Nobody mentions it' …). Seven strings were re-varied to kill it; the family is now 2 of 28, and 'Nobody mentions it' went specifically because it duplicated the move of a PROTECTED keep in another region (floodplains/rags_camp's 'Nobody says anything about it, and nobody moves it back').

The wear stays, the worry goes, and the wolf (the prop's own present_when companion) does the finding. deltas.old: Fresh-turned earth, packed and raised into a long low wall. Someone's been digging with purpose, not just drainage.
deltas.new: Fresh-turned earth, packed and raised into a long low wall. The spoil is thrown to the field side, and a boot-path runs up the near face.
deltas.why: The region's worst single string on the counters: anon-motive 1 + negation-correction 1 + smoke 2, all in one 20-word observe. 'Someone's been digging with purpose, not just drainage' asserts the motive AND corrects an assumption for effect. Replaced with the two facts that DISTINGUISH a rampart from drainage (spoil thrown to the field side, a worn path up the near face) and lets the reader draw the conclusion (§2.3). Its holdout sibling entities[0].toast is byte-frozen and still carries the unfinished-earthwork fact.

_comment_census_and_baseline_regen:
TWO NON-PROSE EDITS THIS LANE HAD TO MAKE, both disclosed here because neither is a prose change.
1. COMMENT CENSUS. `scripts/comment_census.py --check` was RED on the composed tree before this lane touched anything, and the tracked pre-commit hook blocks EVERY `wandering_inn_game/data/` edit while it is red — so the lane could not commit a single string without fixing it. Attribution, measured per commit: main before #396 (41191bb4) 209190/1394716 = 14.999% PASS; #396's merge (752a04ac) 211222/1408283 = 14.999% PASS; the COMPOSED TREE (dbbfb96b, the #397 branch merged into main) 211222/1404281 = 15.041% FAIL. `_comment_chars` never moved: the #397 prose pass SHORTENED player-facing prose corpus-wide by ~4,000 characters, which raised the comment ratio past a 15% target calibrated before the pass. It is the pass's collective doing, not any one region's. FIXED by a comment-economy trim of 807 characters across the four riverfarm map files this lane owns (16 comments), deleting exactly what AGENTS.md says to delete — version tags (v0.15 T4.4, v0.16 #305, v0.16.1 #3), issue-note citations, dates, and one review story ('SUPERSEDES the failed v0.16.1 copy-only disambiguation') — and keeping every trap, cell fact, gate contract, ordering dependency and counter constraint verbatim. Census is now GREEN (210415/1403330 = 14.994%), the first green on this tree. NOTE FOR THE CONTROLLER: riverfarm was already the LEAST commented map dir at 11.7%, so this bought margin in the wrong place. The corpus-level offenders are ruin_surface 32.2%, moods.json 32.0%, seal_vault 31.5%, dungeon_approach 31.1% and inn.json 29.7%; the durable fix is a trim there or a re-calibrated target, not more riverfarm.
2. MAPS VOICE-GATE BASELINE. The PROSE edits needed NO regeneration — the H2 prose-field mask normalises the shipped pre-mask baseline forward, so the gate stayed CLEAN at rc=0 through all 28 string rewrites (verified). The COMMENT trim is a different matter: `_comment` is baked into map_skeleton verbatim, so trimming one is a structure diff and hard-fails the gate by design. Four baseline files were re-snapshotted for that reason and that reason only — riverfarm_mill, riverfarm_village, witch_hollow, witch_hut. riverfarm_longhouse needed no trim and its baseline is untouched. The four are now post-mask (prose slots rendered as the mask) while the other 27 stay pre-mask; the gate handles both, which is what its own self-test 'maps case F' proves, and it re-runs CLEAN at rc=0. The DIALOGUE baseline is untouched: no riverfarm graph was edited.
